intro.label: Opportunities
intro.title: Selected opportunities.
intro.lead: Opportunities reach us through founders, operators, investors and local partners. We share them selectively, with qualified investors and strategic partners, under NDA.
intro.notice: Illustrative examples. The opportunities shown describe the types of mandates we work on. They are not offers and contain no client information. Live opportunities are shared privately with qualified parties.

items.summary: A regional digital infrastructure platform seeking a strategic investor to fund expansion across Saudi Arabia.

sections.overview: An established operator of digital infrastructure services for enterprise and public-sector customers, looking for a strategic investor to accelerate its expansion programme.
sections.market: Enterprise and government digitisation in Saudi Arabia is driving sustained demand for local capacity, connectivity and managed services, with a preference for in-country providers.
sections.business: Recurring, contract-based revenue from enterprise customers, an experienced local management team and an expansion pipeline that requires growth capital.
sections.thesis: Structural demand growth, high switching costs and the value of local presence support long-term, contracted cash flows.
sections.opportunity: A minority or significant minority position alongside the founders, with governance rights and participation in the expansion plan.
sections.rationale: Attractive for investors seeking infrastructure-like exposure to the Saudi digital economy, or for strategic investors adding regional capability.
sections.structure: Primary investment into the operating company or a dedicated expansion vehicle, structured with qualified legal and tax counsel.
sections.next: Qualified investors receive a teaser under NDA, followed by management access and a data room.

items.summary: A proven hospitality software product seeking a GCC partner to launch a regional joint venture.

sections.overview: An international hospitality technology company with a proven product, seeking a regional partner to establish a joint venture for the GCC.
sections.market: New hotel and destination supply across the Gulf is creating demand for modern guest-experience, operations and revenue-management technology.
sections.business: A software platform with an established international customer base, adaptable to Arabic-language and regional operating requirements.
sections.thesis: Pairing a proven product with local relationships shortens sales cycles and builds a defensible regional position.
sections.opportunity: A joint venture combining the technology licence with a partner bringing capital, hospitality relationships and local operations.
sections.rationale: Suits hospitality groups, real estate developers and investors with exposure to the regional tourism pipeline.
sections.structure: A GCC joint-venture company with a technology licence, shared governance and agreed contribution of capital and distribution.
sections.next: Introductory discussion, partner fit assessment and a jointly developed business plan.

items.summary: An applied-AI company serving enterprises in Central Asia, raising growth capital for regional expansion.

sections.overview: A technology company delivering applied-AI products for enterprises in Uzbekistan, with plans to expand across Central Asia and into the GCC.
sections.market: Rapid digitisation of the Uzbek economy and limited local AI capability create room for a focused regional player.
sections.business: Products for document processing, customer service and analytics, sold to enterprise and institutional customers.
sections.thesis: A local team with enterprise references, cost-efficient delivery and a credible path to regional expansion.
sections.opportunity: A growth round to fund product development, sales capacity and entry into neighbouring markets.
sections.rationale: Exposure to Central Asian technology growth with a business that can also serve GCC customers.
sections.structure: Equity investment, potentially through a holding structure, coordinated with qualified counsel.
sections.next: Teaser and management presentation under NDA, followed by commercial and technical due diligence.

items.summary: A sports technology concept looking for a strategic partner to launch in Saudi Arabia.

sections.overview: A sports technology concept serving fans, clubs and venues, prepared for launch in Saudi Arabia with a strategic partner.
sections.market: Investment in sport, events and venues across the Kingdom is creating demand for fan engagement, ticketing and performance technology.
sections.business: A digital platform combining fan engagement and commercial tools for rights holders and venues.
sections.thesis: A strategic partner with sports relationships can unlock distribution and early anchor customers.
sections.opportunity: A strategic partnership or joint venture to launch, localise and commercialise the platform.
sections.rationale: Relevant to sports organisations, media groups and investors building exposure to the sports economy.
sections.structure: Partnership agreement or JV company with defined contributions, governance and economics.
sections.next: Partner discussion, concept review and joint launch plan.

items.summary: Modernising an established industrial business in Uzbekistan through a JV with a technology partner.

sections.overview: An established industrial group in Uzbekistan seeking a technology partner to digitise operations and create a jointly owned solutions business.
sections.market: Industrial modernisation is a national priority, and many producers are still running on manual or legacy processes.
sections.business: An operating industrial business with stable revenue, a modernisation budget and access to sector peers.
sections.thesis: Digitising a lighthouse operation creates a reference case that a JV can then sell across the sector.
sections.opportunity: A joint venture between the industrial group and a European or GCC technology partner.
sections.rationale: Suits industrial technology companies looking for a Central Asian entry point with an anchor customer.
sections.structure: A JV company with technology licensing, implementation services and shared economics.
sections.next: Site assessment, partner matching and a joint business plan.

items.summary: A live platform for running marketing campaigns, partnerships and brand deals — ready to license and launch with a regional partner.

sections.overview: An integrated platform for managing marketing campaigns, partnerships, commercial relationships, digital assets and performance analytics in one environment. Built and operated by Nordic AI, it is already in use in sports marketing (Monetiseur).
sections.market: Brands, agencies and sports organisations across the GCC are moving sponsorship and campaign spend to measurable, digital partnerships, but most still run them on spreadsheets and disconnected tools.
sections.business: A configurable SaaS product: campaign dashboard, partner and deal management, deliverables tracking, digital asset library and built-in analytics, with payouts and approvals in one workflow.
sections.thesis: Proven software that removes years of product development: a regional partner brings the market and customer access, the platform brings a working product from day one.
sections.opportunity: Regional licensing or a joint venture to launch the platform for brands, agencies, clubs and federations in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Central Asia.
sections.rationale: Fits investors and operators building a marketing-technology or sports-commerce business who want a faster, lower-risk route to market than building from scratch.
sections.structure: Licence with localisation and white-label options, or a joint venture with Nordic AI as technology partner — structured with qualified legal counsel.
sections.next: Request a product walkthrough and commercial terms; we arrange a session with the Nordic AI team.

items.summary: A browser-based 3D configurator that designs and prices buildable structures — ready for construction and modular-building partners.

sections.overview: Dojo is a modular 3D configuration engine: customers design a structure in the browser, the engine assembles validated modules into a complete specification and prices it instantly. Built by Nordic AI.
sections.market: Construction, modular housing and prefab manufacturers in the GCC and Central Asia are scaling fast, and buyers increasingly expect to configure and price online before talking to sales.
sections.business: Configurator engine with a module library, rules for what can be built, live pricing and a generated specification that sales and production teams can work from.
sections.thesis: Configuration and instant pricing shorten sales cycles and reduce errors between sale and production — a direct lever on margin for any modular product business.
sections.opportunity: Licensing for a manufacturer or developer, or a regional joint venture offering the configurator to construction and modular-building companies.
sections.rationale: Attractive for construction groups, prefab manufacturers and proptech investors looking for a differentiated, digital sales channel.
sections.structure: Product licence with configuration for the partner's own modules and pricing, or a joint venture with Nordic AI as technology partner.
sections.next: Request a live demo with your own product range; we coordinate the scoping session with Nordic AI.

items.summary: A flexible commerce platform for catalogues, storefronts and transactions across channels — ready to launch for regional retailers and brands.

sections.overview: A digital commerce solution for managing product catalogues, online storefronts, customer journeys and transactions across multiple sales channels, built and running in production by Nordic AI.
sections.market: E-commerce in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Uzbekistan continues to grow quickly, with retailers and distributors looking for platforms they can adapt to local payment, language and logistics needs.
sections.business: Catalogue and inventory management, multi-brand storefronts, checkout and payments, order management and customer accounts, with integrations to ERP and logistics.
sections.thesis: A proven platform lets a regional operator compete on customer experience and speed to market instead of spending years building core commerce infrastructure.
sections.opportunity: Licensing for retailers, distributors and marketplaces, or a joint venture to operate the platform for multiple merchants in the region.
sections.rationale: Suits retail groups, distributors and investors building a regional commerce or marketplace business.
sections.structure: Licence with localisation (Arabic, local payments), white-label deployment, or a joint venture with Nordic AI as technology partner.
sections.next: Request a walkthrough of the storefront and back office, and an outline of commercial terms.

items.summary: A platform for planning, tracking and analysing individual and team performance — ready for enterprises, academies and sports organisations.

sections.overview: An integrated solution for managing individual and team performance: planning activities, tracking progress and analysing results through dashboards and reports. Built by Nordic AI and used for athlete management.
sections.market: Enterprises, education providers and sports organisations across the GCC are investing heavily in people and talent development, and need structured tools to plan and prove progress.
sections.business: Planning for individuals and teams, goal and progress tracking, communication, and analytics dashboards that turn activity into measurable results.
sections.thesis: Performance data is becoming a management standard; a ready platform lets a regional partner serve this demand without building and validating a product first.
sections.opportunity: Licensing for organisations, or a joint venture to offer the platform to sports academies, federations, training providers and corporate teams in the region.
sections.rationale: Relevant for sports investors, education groups and HR-technology operators looking for a proven product.
sections.structure: Product licence with configuration for the partner's programmes, or a joint venture with Nordic AI as technology partner.
sections.next: Request a product demonstration and discuss the target segment and commercial model.

items.summary: An AI-driven back office that reads case documents, structures them and moves each case through its workflow — ready for service businesses.

sections.overview: An AI back-office system that takes in case documents, extracts and structures their contents, and moves each case through its workflow with less manual handling. Built and in production by Nordic AI.
sections.market: Legal, financial, insurance and public-service organisations in the region process large volumes of documents by hand, and AI adoption is a stated priority across the GCC.
sections.business: Document intake, AI extraction and classification, case workflows, task assignment and reporting — with people kept in control of decisions.
sections.thesis: Document-heavy processes are where AI delivers measurable savings fastest; a working product removes the pilot risk that stops most AI programmes.
sections.opportunity: Licensing for an organisation's own back office, or a joint venture offering AI back-office services to firms across the region.
sections.rationale: Fits investors and operators in legal, financial and business services, and groups building an AI services business.
sections.structure: Licence with configuration for the partner's document types and workflows, or a joint venture with Nordic AI as technology partner.
sections.next: Request a demonstration with sample documents from your own process.

items.summary: A hotel and booking management platform for rooms, rates, guests and operations — ready for hospitality groups and new properties.

sections.overview: A configurable platform for managing bookings, rooms and resources, pricing, guest interactions and day-to-day operations through one management system. Built by Nordic AI for hospitality and booking businesses.
sections.market: Hospitality capacity in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Uzbekistan is expanding rapidly, driven by tourism, pilgrimage and events — and new properties need modern systems from opening day.
sections.business: Booking engine, room and rate management, guest profiles and communication, housekeeping and operational workflows, with reporting across one or many properties.
sections.thesis: Every new hotel and serviced-apartment project needs a management system; a proven, configurable platform can be rolled out across a portfolio faster and at lower cost than legacy software.
sections.opportunity: Licensing for hotel groups and operators, or a joint venture to supply the platform to new hospitality projects across the region.
sections.rationale: Relevant for hospitality groups, real-estate developers with hotel components, and investors building a hospitality-technology business.
sections.structure: Licence with configuration for the partner's properties and channels, or a joint venture with Nordic AI as technology partner.
sections.next: Request a walkthrough of the booking and operations modules for your property type.

model.comment: Illustrative investment calculator for partner products. Year-1 revenue (USD m) in Saudi Arabia at the reference investment is opportunity.model.base; revenue = base × market factor × growth[year] × scenario.revenue × (investment / refInvestment)^scaleExp; operating profit = revenue × scenario.margins[year].
